description:

description:
**Job Title:** Lead Generation & Sales Data Analyst

**Location:** Pune

**Experience:** 2–4 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**Work Mode:** Work from Office Shift: 2:00 PM–11:00 PM IST or as required to support US business operations.

**Department:** Sales Operations / Business Development Support

**Job Summary**

Ingeniworx Business Solutions LLP is hiring a detail-oriented Lead Generation & Sales Data Analyst to support a US-focused business development and sales team.

The selected candidate will research approved target companies, identify relevant business decision-makers, verify professional contact information, and maintain accurate lead and client records in the database.

The role will use Apollo, LinkedIn, company websites, the database, and other approved sources to provide the sales team with accurate and actionable prospect data.

This is not a basic data-entry position.

The role requires strong B2B research, analytical ability, data validation, CRM/ATS administration, and an understanding of US companies and decision-making structures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Research US-based target companies assigned by management and sales leadership.
* Identify relevant decision-makers in IT, procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, contingent workforce, talent acquisition, and digital transformation.
* Use Apollo, LinkedIn, company websites, and other approved sources to obtain and validate business contact information.
* Create, update, and maintain prospective-client and contact records in the database. Check the database before creating records to prevent duplicate companies and contacts.
* Validate current company, designation, department, location, business email, telephone number, and LinkedIn profile.
* Standardize company names, domains, industries, job titles, locations, lead sources, and other CRM fields.
* Import data through approved database integrations or controlled bulk-import templates. Assign researched accounts and contacts to the appropriate sales team member.
* Maintain lead source, verification status, ownership, account priority, service line, and follow-up information.
* Update bounced emails, incorrect contact information, job changes, and departed contacts. Maintain do-not-contact, opt-out, and suppression information.
* Provide researched target accounts to the sales team in organized weekly batches.
* Support requests for additional contacts, account refreshes, and meeting-related company research. Audit the data for incomplete, outdated, duplicate, or incorrectly categorized records.
* Prepare regular reports on accounts researched, contacts verified, records added or updated, data quality, sales usage, and resulting meetings or opportunities.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of company, prospect, client, and sales information.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Information Systems, Data Management, or a related discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in B2B lead generation, sales research, CRM administration, data enrichment, market research, or sales operations.
* Experience researching US companies and business decision-makers. Experience using a CRM, ATS, sales-intelligence platform, or B2B contact database.
* Strong online research and data-validation skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including filters, lookups, duplicate identification, and data cleanup.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* Ability to work independently and complete assignments within defined timelines.
* Willingness to work from the Pune or Kolkata office during the assigned shift.

* **Preferred Qualifications:**
* Hands-on experience with ATS.
* Experience using Apollo, ZoomInfo, Seamless, or any other similar platforms.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, SalesIntel, Lusha, RocketReach, ContactOut, or similar platforms.
* Previous experience supporting a US IT staffing, technology consulting, professional services, or B2B sales organization.
* Knowledge of US IT staffing, procurement, strategic sourcing, MSP/VMS programs, and contingent workforce functions.
* Experience with CRM data cleaning, bulk imports, field mapping, duplicate management, and reporting. Familiarity with email verification and contact-data enrichment tools.

description:
***Senior Business Analyst – FinTech & Payments***

**Company:** WebMobril Technologies

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra

**Experience:** 8+ Years

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Job Summary:**

WebMobril Technologies is looking for an experienced **Senior Business Analyst – FinTech & Payments** with 8+ years of Business Analysis experience and mandatory hands-on expertise in Core FinTech, Digital Payments, Banking, or BFSI.

The candidate will be responsible for gathering and translating complex business requirements into detailed functional specifications for an enterprise-grade FinTech platform, working closely with Product, Engineering, UI/UX, QA, DevOps, Operations, Compliance, Banking Partners, and Management teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Gather, analyse, validate, and document business and functional requirements.
* Prepare and maintain BRDs, FRDs, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, use cases, business rules, API requirements, and process flows.
* Define end-to-end workflows, user journeys, system interactions, business rules, validations, exception scenarios, and edge cases.
* Conduct stakeholder workshops, gap analysis, requirement prioritisation, and impact analysis for change requests.
* Collaborate with Product, UI/UX, Engineering, and QA teams to clarify requirements, validate user flows, and support development and testing.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
* Coordinate UAT, business sign-offs, and end-to-end requirement traceability through production release.
* Analyse payment workflows, system integrations, operational dependencies, and opportunities for process improvement.

**Core FinTech & Payments Expertise:**

* Hands-on experience across relevant FinTech products and workflows, including:
* Merchant Onboarding, KYC/KYB, and Merchant Lifecycle Management.
* Payment Gateways, UPI, Payment Links, QR Payments, and Order Management.
* Collections, Payouts/Disbursements, and Bank/Payment Partner Integrations.
* Reconciliation, Settlement, Autopay, and Recurring Payments.
* Refunds, Reversals, Chargebacks, Transaction Monitoring, and Exception Handling.
* Risk & Fraud Management, Customer Support Workflows, Notifications, Reporting, and Analytics.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end payment transaction lifecycle, including successful, failed, pending, reversed, and duplicate transactions, is essential. Knowledge of IMPS, NEFT, and RTGS is also required.

**Required Skills & Technical Knowledge:**

**Business Analysis:** Requirement Gathering, Stakeholder Management, BRD/FRD/PRD Documentation, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Use Cases, Business Process Modelling, Gap Analysis, Requirement Traceability, UAT, and Change Impact Analysis.

**Technical Understanding:**

* Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, API Request/Response Structures, and Third-Party Integrations.
* Webhooks, Callbacks, Event-Driven Architecture, Kafka/Message Queues, and Asynchronous Processing.
* Database Concepts, Basic SQL, System Integration Flows, and High-Level Application Architecture.
* Ability to understand and document complete transaction flows from API Gateway and payment/bank integrations through transaction processing, reconciliation, settlement, and reporting.

**Security & Compliance:**

* Understanding of the RBI and NPCI ecosystem and payment/banking compliance requirements.
* Awareness of PCI-DSS principles, authentication, authorisation, RBAC, merchant-level access, maker-checker workflows, audit trails, data privacy, and basic risk/fraud controls.

**Tools:** JIRA, Confluence, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Figma/FigJam, process documentation tools, and Agile/Scrum project management tools.

Education & Qualifications

**Mandatory:**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of Business Analysis experience.
* Strong, hands-on Core FinTech, Digital Payments, Banking, or BFSI domain experience.
* Proven experience in payment processing, merchant onboarding, KYC/KYB, collections, payouts, reconciliation, and settlement.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder management, communication, and Agile delivery skills.

**Preferred:**

* MBA/PGDM in Finance, Business Management, Banking, FinTech, or a related discipline. Candidates with both B.E./B.Tech and MBA/PGDM will be highly preferred.
* Experience with large-scale FinTech platforms, bank/NPCI/payment partner integrations, microservices, Kafka, and risk/fraud workflows.

**Key Competencies:**

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, excellent documentation and communication, stakeholder management, critical thinking, decision-making, ownership, leadership, and the ability to independently manage complex business and payment workflows.

**Ideal Candidate:**

A technically sound Senior Business Analyst capable of independently converting complex FinTech business requirements into clear functional specifications and bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable payment solutions.

**How to Apply:**

Interested candidates meeting the mandatory criteria are invited to apply with their updated resume, highlighting relevant Business Analysis experience, FinTech/Payments expertise, payment lifecycle knowledge, and technical integration experience.

You can also share your updated CV at **purva.sharma@webmobril.com.**

This role balances strategic product ownership. With hands-on project leadership, ensuring high-impact features are delivered on time, with quality, and aligned to business goals.

* Define and communicate product vision, strategy, and roadmap.

* Collaborate with engineering, UX, and business stakeholders to ensure alignment.

Track and measure product KPIs, feature adoption, and business impact.

* Lead Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Remove impediments and ensure smooth team delivery flow.
* Coach the team on Agile best practices and continuous improvement.
* Shield the team from scope creep and unplanned work.

* Provide transparency into roadmap, release plans, and delivery status.

#BetterDaysStartNow

title: Senior Analyst, Research
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**Sr. Analyst – Research (Location:** Pune)
  
About JLL
  
**JLL (NYSE:** JLL) is a leading professional services firm that specializes in real estate and investment management. Our vision is to reimagine the world of real estate, creating rewarding opportunities and amazing spaces where people can achieve their ambitions. In doing so, we will build a better tomorrow for our clients, our people and our communities. JLL is a Fortune 500 company with annual revenue of $20 billion, operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of more than 115,000 as of 2025\. JLL is the brand name, and a registered trademark, of Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

You will be part of the Real Estate Intelligence Service (REIS) team that tracks real estate trends and advice clients with market reports and insights. The team supports other businesses of JLL with data, insights and contributes towards the thought leaderships, media release and branding of the firm. You will be responsible for tracking Pune’s office, retail and residential markets. In addition, you will keep a close track on policy announcements, state level infrastructure projects’ progress and maintain an appetite for gaining and enhancing your knowledge on the city’s real estate and economic landscape.
  
  

Team work
  
Your responsibilities would be collecting data from various primary sources like visiting developers’ office, project sites and interacting with the relevant internal business lines. Preparing excel data, participating in forecast discussion and writing market reports for Pune are other key responsibilities in this role. You will work closely with the REIS central team and your reporting manager who interact with the APAC team for various submissions.
  
  

**Research and Analytics:**  

You will provide client research including real estate market intelligence studies, location intelligence, construction intelligence, transaction intelligence etc. Conduct primary and secondary research to support assignment\-based and ad\-hoc research queries. You will also provide client research including market trends, key themes and reasoning for any changes in market. You should have a great hand in excel and writing reports.
  
  

**Client and Competitor Intelligence:**  

You will maintain our Pune REIS database and ensure it is kept up to date.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Being Analytical
  
You will be building, maintaining, supporting and validating primary and secondary databases to be used to support our Pune REIS submissions to clients. You will also be extracting valuable information from public data sources ranging from macroeconomic trends, industry developments, company financial information and competitor landscape. You will also be involved in data cleaning, preparation, interpretation and analysis using statistical technique and tools in Excel, Internal CRM database and other data management systems.
  
Meticulous
  
You must pay attention to detail and have excellent problem\-solving skills. Possess the ability to collate information into cohesive presentations with proper slide layout / design.
  
Qualifications
  
You will have a Degree / Diploma or relevant educational background in Real Estate (Planning or Architecture), Economics or Business Administration with min 3\-5 years of working experience.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**  

At JLL, we foster an open and collaborative working environment. This environment, combined with the best minds in the business and supported by a platform of cutting edge research and new gen technology, ensures that you realise your full potential. If you harbour a passion for learning and are interested in new technologies, JLL will continuously provide you with platforms to enrich your technical domains. It’s no surprise that JLL has been recognized by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the 2025 World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 18th consecutive year.
  
  

Apply today!
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Business Analyst - OTC Credit Exposure Processing - Pune - C12 (R2033802)
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


The IT Business Senior Analyst is an intermediate\-level position responsible for liaising between business users and technologists to exchange information in a concise, logical and understandable way in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to contribute to continuous iterative exploration and investigation of business performance and other measures to gain insight and drive business planning.


Responsibilities:


* Understand, analyze and explain counterparty mark\-to\-future exposures on derivative books to regional users.
* Dwell deep into the Potential Future Exposure/EPE/EAD/RWA calculation methodologies for Credit risk/BASEL 3 and be able to verify, cross check the exposure profiles generated by the systems.
* Where feasible develop excel prototypes to generate exposure profiles for basic products
* Ability to trace the changes in day to day exposures to changes in markets, books and/or agreements
* Work closely with developers to improve/refactor code base and ensure agreed changes are manifested correctly by looking analyzing post release exposure numbers
* Conduct meeting with clients and key stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze, finalize and receive formal sign\-off’s from approvers.
* Translate requirements into Business Requirement Document \[BRD], Functional Requirement Document \[FRD] and/or Minor Development Document \[MDD].
* Facilitate and drive project meetings with both business and technology teams.
* Develop and review test scripts with business users as well as technology team. Execute test scripts for System Integration Test (SIT) and User Acceptance Test (UAT).
* Co\-ordinate and/or conduct the Production Acceptance Testing (PAT) with the business users.
* Creates flow diagrams, structure charts, and other types of system or process representations.
* Manage changes to requirements and baseline through a change control process.
* Ability to read code
* Formulate and define systems scope and objectives for complex projects and foster communication between business leaders and IT
* Consult with users and clients to solve complex system issues/problems through in\-depth evaluation of business processes, systems and industry standards and recommends solutions
* Support system change processes from requirements through implementation and provide input based on analysis of information
* Consult with business clients to determine system functional specifications and provides user and operational support
* Identify and communicate risks and impacts, considering business implications of the application of technology to the current business environment
* Act as advisor or coach to new or lower level analysts and work as a team to achieve business objectives, performing other duties and functions as assigned
* Has the ability to operate with a limited level of direct supervision.
* Can exercise independence of judgement and autonomy.
* Acts as SME to senior stakeholders and /or other team members.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

Qualifications:


7\-10 years of relevant experience


* Experience in data analysis with intermediate/advanced Microsoft Office Suite skills
* Proven interpersonal, data analysis, diplomatic, management and prioritization skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication
* Proven ability to manage multiple activities and build/develop working relationships
* Proven self\-motivation to take initiative and master new tasks quickly
* Demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines and approach work methodically with attention to detail

Education:


MANDATORY: BE, ME, M Tech, B Tech, MBA


PREFERRED: FRM/CFA is preferred, Degree in financial mathematics, quantitative finance is ideal


The successful candidate must:


Work to agreed deadlines as part of the remote development environment
  

Have experience of working cooperatively in small to medium sized teams.
  

Be able to work on own initiative.
